P.U. (A) 519.
MALAYSIA ACT

IN '&xercise of the powers conferred by section 74 of the Malaysia Act,
the Yang di-Pertuan Agong hereby makes the following order:

1. This order may be cited as the Modification of Laws (Census)
(Modification and Extension to East Malaysia) Order, 1969.

The Census Act, 1960 (hereinafter referred to as the Act), is hereby
modified in the manner set out in the Schedule to this Order.

3. The Act as modified by Article 2 is hereby extended to Sabah and

Sarawak.

4. The Census Ordinances of Sdbah and Sarawak are hereby repealed.
